note: Play in stage order. Stages 1 and 2 overlap: the missable moments in stage 2 happen during the story missions of stage 1, so read stage 2 before you start chapter 2 — Cal's fishing challenge and Bret's hunt can both appear while the story is still early.

stages.summary: Work through Gone Fishing and the four chapters in order, taking the named story missions as they unlock. Story trophies cannot be missed, but the eight missable moments in stage 2 hide inside these chapters, so keep that list open while you play.
stages.tip: Finish every story mission before the finale, and re-check the missable flags at the end of each chapter.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story, chapters 1 to 4

stages.summary: Eight trophies can only be earned at one-time story moments or choices. Take each one the first time it is offered: Cal's fishing challenge, Bret's unique-animal hunt, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom smash-out, the partnership scene, a story choice, the second-attempt moment, and the strange encounter. A missed one means a new playthrough.
stages.tip: Save before every story choice and every one-time scene, so a missed moment costs a reload, not a replay.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Grab the missable moments (do these during stage 1)

stages.summary: Finish the mission strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, then complete eight stranger strands across Leonida. These missions wait for you, so they are perfect filler between story chapters.
stages.tip: Check the map for stranger markers after every chapter — new ones appear as the story advances.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Stranger strands and contacts

stages.summary: Sweep Leonida region by region: photograph 100 WAiNK It spots, complete 3 collectible card sets, discover 100 vehicles, and visit all 52 areas of the state. Doing these together saves hours of backtracking.
stages.tip: Pair the WAiNK sweep with the exploration sweep — one road trip covers both counters.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Collectibles and exploration

stages.summary: The long grind: 250 stunts, gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 20 different race wins, drone races at all 14 locations, 50 challenges, 18 meditation spots, the arcade, the partner robberies, the bank vaults and the money goals. Chase the lowest counters first and let the rest fall as you play.
stages.tip: Open the challenges menu after every session and clear the easiest unfinished categories first.
stages.title: Stage 5 — Activities, challenges and clean-up

stages.summary: With 54 trophies earned, the platinum pops on its own. Confirm the counter reads 54 of 54, then enjoy being a Leonida Legend.
stages.tip: The 100% completion gold usually lands last — check the stats page before the final push.
stages.title: Stage 6 — Platinum: Vice Got a Price!

title: Road to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
